description: Structural limits for operator-supplied profile, metadata and assetSchema JSON. The server and offline signer MUST enforce these exact values; their tests compare hardcoded limits with this file. Changing a value is a frozen-contract change.
maxStringLengthUnit: UTF-8 bytes (Go len(string)/the length of the value's UTF-8 encoding, NOT Unicode scalar values/runes and NOT UTF-16 code units). Applies identically to string values and object property keys, so to every JSON string token in the document. FROZEN: see docs/spec/asset-profile.md 'Structural limits'.
